references.text: Mount Sinai was in smoke because the Lord had descended on it in fire - the same description of the mountain burning with fire
The glory of the Lord was like a consuming fire on top of the mountain - parallel to the mountain burning
Moses received the two tablets of the testimony, stone tablets written by the finger of God - the same two tablets that Moses carried down from the mountain
Moses turned and went down from the mountain with the two tablets of the testimony in his hands - a direct parallel to the action in Deuteronomy 9:15
The mountain burned with fire all the way up to heaven - the same event where the mountain burns with fire
The Lord spoke to the entire assembly from the fire and gave Moses the two stone tablets - context for the tablets Moses received
Reference to the burning mountain that the Israelites came to - The New Testament refers to the event at Sinai
